item.title: What will Trump’s latest sweeping tariffs mean for the world?
item.description: The US president has injected new uncertainty into the global economy with a 15 percent tariff on all imports.

item.title: Violence erupts in Mexico after killing of drug cartel kingpin ‘El Mencho’
item.description: Violence erupts in several states after one of the most powerful cartel leaders in Mexico is killed in army operation.

item.title: Brazil does not want ‘a new Cold War’, says President Lula
item.description: Lula says he wants to tell US President Trump that Brazil wishes for all countries to be treated 'equally'.

item.title: White House post after US hockey win over Canada stirs controversy
item.description: Trump hails US's Olympic gold win, as some Canadians reject White House's illustration of an eagle dominating a goose.

item.title: North Korea’s Kim Jong Un re-elected as chief of Workers’ Party
item.description: Kim says his party is focused on the tasks of 'boosting economic construction and the people's standard of living'.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,460
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,460 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: One Battle After Another triumphs at UK’s BAFTA film awards
item.description: The offbeat thriller has won six BAFTAs, including best film and best director for Paul Thomas Anderson.

item.title: Hong Kong court rejects appeal in landmark subversion case
item.description: Appellants were among 45 opposition figures sentenced to prison in 2024 for organising an unofficial primary election.

item.title: How Modi ‘broke down walls’ between India, Israel – at Palestine’s expense
item.description: Under Modi, India, a long supporter of the Palestinian cause, has found a friend in Israel's Netanyahu despite genocide.

item.title: ICC to hold hearings on charges against ex-Philippine President Duterte
item.description: Duterte faces three counts of crimes against humanity allegedly committed during his time as president and Davao mayor.
